responsibility: Provides the principal target macro header for the rs6000 backend. It defines object-format and ABI-selection macros, assembler/driver spec fragments, target defaults, register and builtin-type declarations, machine_function layout, constant-range helpers, hook macro bindings, and countless compile-time policies that parameterize the PowerPC backend before and during compilation, serving as the primary preprocessor-level configuration interface for rs6000 targets.
same_name_distinction: Within the core rs6000 group, this is the principal macro/configuration header: it declares compile-time target interfaces, object-format and ABI macros, builtin type declarations, and machine_function state, rather than implementing hooks (rs6000.cc), defining RTL patterns (rs6000.md), or listing options (rs6000.opt).
